#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long pow_mod(long long x, long long y) {
    if (y == 0) return 1LL;
    if (x == 1) return 1LL;
    long long p = pow_mod(x, y / 2) % MOD;
    p = p * p % MOD;
    if (y % 2 == 1) {
        p = p * x % MOD;
    }
    return p;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    long long cnt = r - l + 1;
    long long cells = n * m;
    long long answer;

    if ((n % 2 == 1) && (m % 2 == 1)) {
        answer = pow_mod(cnt, cells);
    } else {
        long long p = pow_mod(cnt, cells - 1);
        long long inv2 = pow_mod(2, MOD - 2);
        if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
            answer = p * (cnt / 2) % MOD;
        } else {
            long long add = p * ((cnt + 1) / 2) % MOD;
            long long sub = (p - 1 + MOD) % MOD * inv2 % MOD;
            answer = (add - sub + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
